POWER SKILL #4

WHY SETTING BOUNDARIES IS HARD

When "no" feels impossible, you say yes to everything and quietly resent it later. In the moment, the discomfort of disappointing someone feels bigger than the cost of taking it all on, so "yes" slips out before you've decided. The cost lands later, in time and energy you didn't have.

When "no" feels impossible, you say yes to everything and quietly resent it later. In the moment, the discomfort of disappointing someone feels bigger than the cost of taking it all on, so "yes" slips out before you've decided. The cost lands later, in time and energy you didn't have.

Boundaries aren't about being difficult. They're how you protect your time and energy, and they get easier with practice. This workbook of boundaries worksheets lets you rehearse the "no" until it's yours, in your own words.

Won’t setting boundaries upset people?

Sometimes a boundary gets tested, and the workbook plans for that too. A clear, kind ‘no’ usually protects a relationship more than a resentful ‘yes’ does.

What format is the workbook?

A printable PDF you can fill in on screen or print at home. It opens on a computer, tablet, or phone.

Can I just buy this one?

Yes. Every Power Skill workbook is $15 on its own. The $79 bundle is the lower-cost way to get all nine.

Is this the same as the free workbook?

No. The free Adulting Like A Champ workbook is the front door. This goes deeper on one Power Skill.

Can I get a refund?

You are fully protected by our 100% Satisfaction Guarantee. If you and your learner aren’t satisfied within 30 days of purchase, just let us know and we’ll send a prompt refund. No refunds are issued beyond this 30-day period.

What if I need it on a different device?

It works on a computer, tablet, or phone. Download it once and use it wherever you like.

When "no" feels impossible, you say yes to everything and quietly resent it later. In the moment, the discomfort of disappointing someone feels bigger than the cost of taking it all on, so "yes" slips out before you've decided. The cost lands later, in time and energy you didn't have.
